checklist.notes: The manage sense of run, past-perfect relationships, and consonant-to-vowel linking are practised separately and combined in speaking.
Repeated contextual contrast establishes the target sense, and controlled marked linking precedes freer production.
Fill-blank and construction lead to reading, integrated speaking, and translation, with a sensible rise to the hard oral task.
Meaning and grammar requirements are explicit, although underscore notation needs interpretation as a practice mark rather than normal spelling.
The integrated speaking task combines grammar, polysemy, and linking but gives two concrete constraints and a clear rubric.
Vietnamese-to-English translation plus connected-speech noticing offers useful cross-linguistic support without generalizing about all Vietnamese learners.
Four controlled responses and one bounded spoken account are proportionate for B1.1.

findings.description: The nonstandard underscore in “run_an” can be mistaken for required written English rather than a temporary pronunciation-boundary mark.
findings.recommendation: Add a one-line legend stating that the underscore marks linking practice and should not appear in ordinary writing.

limitations: This is an independent AI pedagogical review for development evidence, not human review or release approval.
